clauses.mechanism: express revocation by EO 12553 (listed by number in its table; effective on signing, no effective-date wording)
clauses.reason: whole: EO 11650 (signed 1972-02-16, 37 FR 3739) orders, under section 6103(a) of the Internal Revenue Code of 1954, that returns for stated taxes 'shall be open to inspection' by certain classes of persons and State and Federal Government establishments in accordance with Treasury Decision 6543 and its amendments. The order is a single continuing authorization. The operative words include "is hereby ordered that returns made in respect of the taxes imposed by". First end: EO 12553 (signed 1986-02-25): "it is hereby ordered that the following Executive Orders, and" and "any amendments thereto, are revoked:" followed by a two-column 'No. Subject' table; the entry at offset 25703 of the held EO_12553.txt reads "11650 Providing for inspection of tax returns by certain persons and State and Federal establishments", which matches this order's number and subject. EO 12553 has no effective-date wording, so the revocation is read as effective on signing, 1986-02-25. The Office of the Federal Register catalog note reads "Revoked by: EO 12553, February 25, 1986". Held U.S. Code editorial note (release point 119-121): "Executive Orders 10738, 10906, 10954, 10962, 11102, 11206, 11213, 11650, and 11706, listed above, were revoked by Ex. Ord. No. 12553, Feb. 25, 1986, 51 F.R. 7237." (26 note to 26 U.S.C. 6103)
